StorageManagementService(8) System Manager's Manual StorageManagementService(8)

NAME

StorageManagementService — Storage Management

SYNOPSIS

StorageManagementService

DESCRIPTION

StorageManagementService is the system daemon backing the Storage section of System Preferences.

There are no configuration options to StorageManagementService, and users should not run StorageManagementService manually.

macOS 05/09/22 StorageManagementService(8)
